Strawberry and Chocolate Chip Panini
By: Chef Sowmya
Published: Thursday, August 1, 2013 - 1:33pm

Ingredients




Sliced strawberries
Chocolate chips- handful
2 slices of sourdough bread
Olive oil and brush

Preparation

1 Open up the slices of sourdough bread 2 Brush it wit some olive oil on either side 3 Add a layer of strawberries and chocolate chips 4 Put it in the panini press! 5 Serve it hot with a side of fresh cut berries!

About

Delicious Panini with fresh strawberries and chocolate chips
